name: hcapp_updateRunPhotoEditedBlob
description: Saves the URL of a Hash-Flash-edited (cropped) version of a run photo. Writes only KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — the original BlobUrl is never modified; callers should always start a re-edit from BlobUrl. If the run's cover (HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl, a COPY of the chosen photo's URL) currently holds this photo's original or previous edit, it is re-pointed at the new edit (2026-09-12); a cover showing another photo is left alone. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 48). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'editPhoto' for @kennelId (else 1334 / 3). @photoId + @kennelId must match a row (else 4040 / 3).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the photo. Used for auth scope and included in the UPDATE WHERE clause. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 2).

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: Photo to update. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 2). If the combination of @photoId + @kennelId matches no row (@@ROWCOUNT=0 after UPDATE), a 'Photo not found' error is returned (errorCode 4040, errorType 3).

parameters.name: editedBlobUrl
parameters.description: Blob URL of the cropped/edited version. Must be non-empty (LEN check after LTRIM/RTRIM). Triggers a validation error if empty or whitespace-only.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. Failure: success = 0 with ValidateAppAuth codes, 1234 / 2 missing parameter, 1334 / 3 not authorised, 4040 / 3 photo not found, 1933 / 5 unhandled. Success: success = 1, errorCode / errorType NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.description: Returned only on auth, validation, photo-not-found, role check, or unhandled DB error. Not present on success.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.KennelPhotos SET EditedBlobUrl = @editedBlobUrl, UpdatedAt = GETUTCDATE() WHERE id = @photoId AND KennelId = @kennelId.

UPDATE HC.Event SET EventCoverPhotoUrl = @editedBlobUrl for the photo's run, only when the cover currently equals this photo's BlobUrl or previous EditedBlobUrl. Fires the Event updatedAt trigger, so the run re-syncs.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on validation failure, refusal, not found, or unhandled error.

codeSmells.detail: All five parameters (@deviceId, @accessToken, @kennelId, @photoId, @editedBlobUrl) (lines 3-7) have no SQL default. A client that omits one is refused by SQL before the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and any graceful check inside is unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29).

Lines 121-157 update HC.KennelPhotos and then HC.Event with no BEGIN TRANSACTION. If the Event UPDATE fails, the CATCH (line 162) returns 1933 but the photo's EditedBlobUrl is already committed and the cover still shows the old crop — the partial state the 2026-09-12 change set out to prevent. The CATCH has no ROLLBACK because there is nothing to roll back.

codeSmells.issue: errorType 3 used for both refusal and not-found
codeSmells.detail: Lines 97 and 129: a permission refusal (1334) and a missing photo (4040) share errorType 3; other SPs use 13 for refusals.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
